sub_category: Basic income support for female heads of families
benefit_summary: Monthly basic income support of Rs 1,200 for SC/ST women and Rs 1,000 for other women who are female heads of families in West Bengal.

name_en: Uttar Pradesh Mukhya Mantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana
name_hi: उत्तर प्रदेश मुख्यमंत्री कन्या सुमंगला योजना
ministry: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
sub_category: Staged cash incentives from birth to graduation for girl child
benefit_summary: Cash incentives of up to Rs 25,000 distributed in 6 phased stages from birth, vaccinations, Class 1, Class 6, Class 9 admission, to Degree/Diploma enrolment.

ministry: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Rajasthan
sub_category: Staged cash grant for girl child birth & education
benefit_summary: Financial assistance of up to Rs 50,000 in 6 instalments to parents of girl children born in government hospitals, linked with immunization, Class 1, 6, 10, and 12 schooling.

name_en: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme (Pudhumai Penn - TN)
ministry: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
sub_category: Monthly stipend for girl students in higher education
benefit_summary: Rs 1,000 per month deposited directly into bank accounts of girl students who studied in Government schools (Class 6-12) until they complete their UG degree/diploma.

ministry: Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Karnataka
benefit_summary: Financial bond in the name of girl child born in BPL family maturing into substantial corpus at age 18, along with annual scholarships and health cover.

ministry: Social Welfare / Education Department, Government of Bihar
sub_category: Cash reward from birth to graduation
benefit_summary: Financial incentives from birth to graduation (including Rs 25,000 upon passing Class 12 unmarried and Rs 50,000 upon graduation for every girl student in Bihar).

name_en: Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS under PMAY)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
sub_category: Home loan interest subsidy for EWS/LIG/MIG
benefit_summary: Upfront interest subsidy of up to 6.5% on home loans (saving up to Rs 2.67 lakh over loan tenure) for purchase or construction of pucca house.

ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
sub_category: Affordable urban rental housing for migrants
benefit_summary: Converts government-funded vacant housing and encourages private/public entities to build affordable rental housing for urban migrants and poor near workplaces.

name_en: SVAMITVA Scheme (Survey of Villages and Mapping with Improvised Technology)
name_hi: स्वामित्व योजना (ग्रामीण आबादी भूमि सर्वेक्षण एवं अधिकार अभिलेख)
ministry: Ministry of Panchayati Raj
benefit_summary: Drone-based surveying of inhabited rural lands to issue official legal 'Property Cards' enabling villagers to use houses as financial collateral for bank loans.

name_en: Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation (AMRUT 2.0)
name_hi: अमृत 2.0 (कायाकल्प एवं शहरी परिवर्तन के लिए अटल मिशन)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
sub_category: Universal tap water and sewerage infrastructure
benefit_summary: Provides universal piped drinking water supply coverage to all households across statutory towns and expands sewage/septage management.

name_hi: जल जीवन मिशन (हर घर जल योजना)
ministry: Ministry of Jal Shakti
sub_category: Functional household tap connection in rural India
benefit_summary: Provides safe, potable piped drinking water through Individual Functional Household Tap Connections (FHTC) of 55 litres per capita per day to every rural home.

ministry: Housing Department, Government of Maharashtra
benefit_summary: Computerized transparent lottery for high-quality, subsidized residential flats developed by MHADA in Mumbai, Pune, Konkan, and Nagpur regions.

name_en: CIDCO Mass Housing Lottery Scheme (Navi Mumbai)
ministry: Urban Development Department, Government of Maharashtra
sub_category: Mass housing apartments in Navi Mumbai
benefit_summary: Affordable multi-storey transit-oriented housing flats offered via lottery in Navi Mumbai nodes (Taloja, Kharghar, Dronagiri, Ulwe) with PMAY subsidy integration.

ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs / DDA
benefit_summary: Freehold residential apartments in prime Delhi locations (Narela, Dwarka, Jasola, Rohini) through transparent online allotment and FCFS schemes.

name_en: Tamil Nadu Housing Board (TNHB) Flat & Plot Schemes
ministry: Housing and Urban Development Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit_summary: Affordable housing plots and built-up apartments across Chennai, Coimbatore, Madurai, and other districts with transparent online booking.

ministry: Rural Development Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
sub_category: 100% state-funded pucca houses for deprived families
benefit_summary: Direct financial grant of Rs 1.20 lakh (plains) / Rs 1.30 lakh per family for constructing a pucca house with toilet and solar power for marginalized families left out of SECC lists.

name_en: West Bengal Banglar Awas / Banglar Bari Scheme
ministry: Panchayats & Rural Development Department, Government of WB
sub_category: State financial assistance for rural pucca homes
benefit_summary: State-supported financial grant of Rs 1.20 lakh per family in installments to build durable pucca houses for economically backward rural households in West Bengal.

ministry: Panchayati Raj and Drinking Water Department, Government of Odisha
sub_category: Conversion of kutcha houses to pucca houses
benefit_summary: Financial assistance of Rs 1.20 lakh (non-IAP districts) / Rs 1.30 lakh (IAP districts) plus wage support under MGNREGA for converting all kutcha houses to disaster-resilient pucca houses.

name_en: Rajasthan Housing Board (RHB) Flat & Villa Schemes
name_hi: राजस्थान आवासन मंडल गृह निर्माण योजनाएं
ministry: Urban Development and Housing Department, Government of Rajasthan
benefit_summary: Subsidized residential houses, villas, and multi-storey apartments across Jaipur, Jodhpur, Kota, and Udaipur with up to 50% discount schemes on unsold properties.

ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
sub_category: Credit-linked margin money subsidy for new micro units
benefit_summary: Credit-linked subsidy of 15% to 35% on project costs up to Rs 50 lakh for manufacturing units and Rs 20 lakh for service units.

name_en: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises
name_hi: सूक्ष्म एवं लघु उद्यमों के लिए क्रेडिट गारंटी फंड ट्रस्ट
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
benefit_summary: Third-party credit guarantee cover of up to 85% for collateral-free bank credit up to Rs 5 crore for new and existing Micro & Small enterprises.

name_en: Scheme of Fund for Regeneration of Traditional Industries
name_hi: पारंपरिक उद्योगों के उत्थान के लिए निधि योजना
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
benefit_summary: Financial assistance of up to Rs 2.5 crore (Regular cluster) / Rs 5 crore (Major cluster) for establishing Common Facility Centres, modern tooling, and design value-chains.

name_en: ASPIRE (Scheme for Promotion of Innovation, Rural Industry & Entrepreneurship)
name_hi: एस्पायर (नवाचार, ग्रामीण उद्योग एवं उद्यमिता संवर्धन योजना)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
sub_category: Livelihood business incubators & fund of funds
benefit_summary: One-time 100% grant of up to Rs 1 crore to establish Livelihood Business Incubators (LBI) in agro-rural sectors, creating new micro-enterprises.

name_hi: एमएसएमई सतत (जेड) प्रमाणन योजना (जीरो डिफेक्ट जीरो इफेक्ट)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
benefit_summary: Financial subsidy of up to 80% (Micro), 60% (Small), and 50% (Medium) on ZED certification cost, plus additional 10% for women/SC/ST/NER enterprises.

name_hi: एमएसएमई चैंपियंस योजना (डिजाइन, आईपीआर एवं इन्क्यूबेशन)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
sub_category: Design assistance, patent grant & idea incubation
benefit_summary: Financial grant up to Rs 15 lakh per approved innovative idea, up to Rs 40 lakh for student/design projects, and reimbursement of patent/trademark filing fees.

name_en: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Subordinate Debt (CGSSD)
name_hi: अधीनस्थ ऋण के लिए क्रेडिट गारंटी योजना
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
sub_category: Debt revival for stressed and NPA MSMEs
benefit_summary: Promoters of stressed/NPA MSME units given credit support equal to 15% of their stake (max Rs 75 lakh) with 90% credit guarantee from CGTMSE.

ministry: Ministry of Finance / Ministry of MSME
benefit_summary: Institutional electronic platform enabling MSMEs to auction and discount trade invoices/bills against large buyers and PSUs through multiple financiers at competitive rates.

name_hi: उत्तर प्रदेश मुख्यमंत्री युवा स्वरोजगार योजना
ministry: Department of MSME and Export Promotion, Government of Uttar Pradesh
sub_category: Margin money loan subsidy for youth businesses
benefit_summary: Loans up to Rs 25 lakh for manufacturing and Rs 10 lakh for service sector with 25% state margin money subsidy (max Rs 6.25 lakh).

ministry: Department of Industries, Government of Bihar
sub_category: 10 lakh enterprise package (50% grant + 50% interest-free loan)
benefit_summary: Package of Rs 10 lakh for starting a new industrial enterprise: Rs 5 lakh as 100% grant/subsidy and Rs 5 lakh as interest-free loan (1% for general men) repayable in 84 instalments.

name_en: New Entrepreneur-cum-Enterprise Development Scheme (NEEDS - Tamil Nadu)
name_hi: नवीन उद्यमी एवं उद्यम विकास योजना (नीड्स - तमिलनाडु)
ministry: Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
sub_category: Capital subsidy & interest subvention for first-gen entrepreneurs
benefit_summary: 25% capital subsidy (up to Rs 75 lakh) on project cost between Rs 10 lakh and Rs 5 crore, plus 3% interest subvention for educated first-generation entrepreneurs.

name_en: Maharashtra Package Scheme of Incentives (PSI for MSME)
ministry: Industries Department, Government of Maharashtra
sub_category: Industrial promotion subsidy & electricity duty exemption
benefit_summary: Basket of financial incentives including SGST reimbursement up to 100% of Fixed Capital Investment, 5% interest subsidy, and electricity duty exemption for 7-10 years.

name_en: Rajasthan Mukhyamantri Laghu Udyog Protsahan Yojana (MLUPY)
name_hi: राजस्थान मुख्यमंत्री लघु उद्योग प्रोत्साहन योजना
ministry: Industries and Commerce Department, Government of Rajasthan
sub_category: Interest subsidy on loans up to Rs 10 crore
benefit_summary: Substantial interest subsidy of 8% on loans up to Rs 25 lakh, 6% on loans up to Rs 5 crore, and 5% on loans up to Rs 10 crore for setting up new manufacturing/service ventures in Rajasthan.

name_en: Gujarat MSME Capital Investment & Interest Subsidy Scheme
name_hi: गुजरात एमएसएमई पूंजी निवेश एवं ब्याज सहायता योजना
ministry: Industries and Mines Department, Government of Gujarat
sub_category: Capital investment subsidy & term loan interest subsidy
benefit_summary: Capital investment subsidy up to 25% of eligible plant and machinery (max Rs 35 lakh) and interest subsidy of 5% to 7% per annum on term loans for 5-7 years in Gujarat.

ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
benefit_summary: Direct government stipend support of 25% of prescribed stipend (up to Rs 1,500/month per apprentice) directly to bank accounts through DBT for on-the-job industrial training.

ministry: Ministry of Labour and Employment
sub_category: Free nationwide job matching & career counselling
benefit_summary: Free digital platform linking jobseekers with verified private and public employers, offering free online career assessments, job fairs, and counselling at 400+ Model Career Centres.

name_en: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission
name_hi: दीनदयाल अंत्योदय योजना - राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण आजीविका मिशन
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
sub_category: Women SHG promotion, revolving fund & interest subvention
benefit_summary: Mobilizes rural women into Self Help Groups, providing Revolving Funds (Rs 20,000-30,000), Community Investment Funds (up to Rs 2.5 lakh), and collateral-free bank loans at 7% interest.

name_en: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Urban Livelihoods Mission
name_hi: दीनदयाल अंत्योदय योजना - राष्ट्रीय शहरी आजीविका मिशन
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
benefit_summary: Subsidised bank loans up to Rs 2 lakh for individual micro-enterprises (Rs 10 lakh for group enterprises) with interest rate capped at 7%, plus free certified placement-linked urban skill training.

name_en: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana
name_hi: दीन दयाल उपाध्याय ग्रामीण कौशल्या योजना
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
benefit_summary: Completely free residential skill training with mandatory minimum 70% guaranteed placement in formal sector jobs offering minimum wages or above.

name_en: Scheme for Higher Education Youth in Apprenticeship and Skills (SHREYAS)
name_hi: शिक्षुता एवं कौशल में उच्च शिक्षा युवाओं के लिए योजना (श्रेयस)
ministry: Ministry of Education / MoSDE
benefit_summary: Integrates apprenticeship and professional skill development into general degree courses (BA, BSc, BCom), enabling students to earn monthly stipends while pursuing degrees.

name_en: Rajasthan Mukhyamantri Yuva Sambal Yojana (Unemployment Allowance)
name_hi: राजस्थान मुख्यमंत्री युवा संबल योजना (बेरोजगारी भत्ता)
ministry: Department of Skill, Employment and Entrepreneurship, Government of Rajasthan
sub_category: Monthly unemployment allowance with skill internship
benefit_summary: Monthly allowance of Rs 4,000 for male graduates and Rs 4,500 for female/transgender/specially-abled graduates for up to 2 years while doing a daily 4-hour government department internship.

ministry: Department of Skill Development, Entrepreneurship and Livelihood, Govt of Karnataka
sub_category: Direct monthly financial support for unemployed graduates
benefit_summary: Monthly financial assistance of Rs 3,000 for unemployed degree holders and Rs 1,500 for unemployed diploma holders for up to 2 years or until employment.

name_en: Madhya Pradesh Mukhyamantri Sikho Kamao Yojana (Learn & Earn)
name_hi: मध्य प्रदेश मुख्यमंत्री सीखो कमाओ योजना
ministry: Technical Education, Skill Development & Employment Department, Government of MP
benefit_summary: On-the-job industrial skill training across 700+ courses with direct monthly stipend of Rs 8,000 (Class 12), Rs 8,500 (ITI), Rs 9,000 (Diploma), and Rs 10,000 (Graduates/Post-Graduates).

name_en: Tamil Nadu Skill Development Corporation (TNSDC) Free Placement Training
name_hi: तमिलनाडु कौशल विकास निगम (टीएनएसडीसी) निःशुल्क प्रशिक्षण
ministry: Labour Welfare and Skill Development Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit_summary: Free government-sponsored short-term skill training in emerging technology, manufacturing, healthcare, and logistics sectors with placement assistance across Tamil Nadu.

name_en: Scheme of Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances (ADIP)
name_hi: दिव्यांगजनों को सहायक उपकरण खरीद/फिटिंग सहायता योजना (एडिप)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
sub_category: Free modern assistive devices & cochlear implants
benefit_summary: Free distribution of modern aids and high-tech appliances (motorized tricycles, smart canes, digital hearing aids, prosthetics, and cochlear implants up to Rs 6 lakh).

ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
sub_category: Free physical aids for senior citizens
benefit_summary: Free provision of age-related physical aids and assisted-living devices (walking sticks, elbow crutches, walkers, tripods, hearing aids, wheelchairs, dentures, and spectacles) to BPL senior citizens.

ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefit_summary: National online database creating a single universal photo ID card for persons with disabilities, enabling pan-India validation for all government concessions, pensions, and transport discounts.

name_en: National Family Benefit Scheme (NFBS under NSAP)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
sub_category: Lump-sum cash grant upon death of primary breadwinner
benefit_summary: One-time lump-sum financial assistance of Rs 20,000 to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) household upon the death of the primary breadwinner (aged 18-59 years).

ministry: Ministry of Rural Development / Ministry of Consumer Affairs
sub_category: Free monthly foodgrains for destitute seniors
benefit_summary: Provides 10 kg of foodgrains (wheat/rice) completely free of charge per month to destitute senior citizens aged 65 and above who are not receiving any pension under NOAPS.

name_en: Maharashtra Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Anudan Yojana
name_hi: महाराष्ट्र संजय गांधी निराधार अनुदान योजना
ministry: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra
sub_category: Monthly financial assistance for destitute, disabled, and single women
benefit_summary: Monthly pension of Rs 1,500 for a single beneficiary (and Rs 2,500 if there are 2 or more beneficiaries in a family) for destitute individuals, blind/disabled, and abandoned women in Maharashtra.

name_en: Maharashtra Shravanbal Seva Rajya Nivruttivetan Yojana
name_hi: महाराष्ट्र श्रावणबाळ सेवा राज्य निवृत्तीवेतन योजना
ministry: Social Justice and Special Assistance Department, Government of Maharashtra
sub_category: Old age pension for non-BPL and BPL senior citizens
benefit_summary: Monthly old age pension of Rs 1,500 to senior citizens aged 65 and above residing in Maharashtra whose annual family income does not exceed Rs 50,000.

name_en: UP Vridhavastha Pension Yojana (Old Age Pension)
ministry: Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
benefit_summary: Monthly direct cash pension of Rs 1,000 per month deposited quarterly (Rs 3,000 per quarter) into bank accounts of eligible senior citizens aged 60+ in Uttar Pradesh.

ministry: Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities Department, Government of UP
benefit_summary: Monthly pension of Rs 1,000 deposited quarterly into bank accounts of persons with 40% or more disability living below poverty line in Uttar Pradesh.

name_en: Rajasthan Social Security Pension Scheme (SSP Portal)
ministry: Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Government of Rajasthan
sub_category: Unified state monthly pensions with mandatory 15% annual increment
benefit_summary: Minimum assured pension of Rs 1,150 per month (increasing automatically by 15% every year under Rajasthan Minimum Income Guarantee Act) for elderly, widows, and disabled.

name_en: Tamil Nadu Old Age Pension Scheme (Indira Gandhi OAP / Destitute)
ministry: Revenue and Disaster Management Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
sub_category: State monthly destitute old age pension
benefit_summary: Monthly cash pension of Rs 1,000 deposited through direct bank transfer or doorstep delivery for destitute senior citizens aged 60 and above in Tamil Nadu.

ministry: Social Security & Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities Department, Govt of Odisha
sub_category: Comprehensive destitute, old age & disability monthly pension
benefit_summary: Monthly social security pension ranging from Rs 1,000 to Rs 1,400 per month (depending on age 60-79 vs 80+) for elderly, widows, PwDs, and transgender persons in Odisha.

ministry: Panchayat Raj and Rural Development Department, Government of Telangana
sub_category: High-value monthly pension for vulnerable groups
benefit_summary: Substantial monthly pension of Rs 2,016 per month for elderly (57+ yrs), widows, and weavers; and Rs 3,016 per month for persons with disabilities in Telangana.

ministry: Panchayat Raj & Rural Development Department, Government of Andhra Pradesh
benefit_summary: Doorstep delivery of monthly pension of Rs 3,000 per month for elderly and widows, and up to Rs 6,000 to Rs 10,000 for severe disability and chronic kidney dialysis patients in AP.

name_en: National Savings Recurring Deposit Account (Post Office 5-Year RD)
name_hi: राष्ट्रीय बचत आवर्ती जमा खाता (डाकघर 5 वर्षीय आरडी)
ministry: Ministry of Finance / Ministry of Communications
benefit_summary: Safe 5-year recurring deposit scheme offering 6.7% p.a. sovereign guaranteed return with loan facility up to 50% of credit balance after 1 year.

name_en: National Savings Time Deposit Account (Post Office 5-Year TD)
name_hi: राष्ट्रीय बचत सावधि जमा खाता (डाकघर 5 वर्षीय टीडी)
ministry: Ministry of Finance / Ministry of Communications
benefit_summary: Fixed 5-year term deposit offering 7.5% p.a. sovereign interest with Section 80C tax deduction benefit on investment.

ministry: Ministry of Communications
sub_category: Liquid basic savings account with tax exemption
benefit_summary: Basic liquid savings account with ATM card, mobile banking, and Section 10(15)(i) tax exemption on interest up to Rs 3,500/year (Rs 7,000 for joint account).

ministry: Ministry of Finance
sub_category: Government gold bond with interest payout
interest_rate: 2.50% p.a. fixed interest + Gold capital appreciation
benefit_summary: Government securities denominated in grams of gold paying 2.50% fixed annual interest with 100% Capital Gains Tax exemption on redemption after 8 years.

name_en: India Post Payments Bank (IPPB) Doorstep Digital Account
name_hi: इंडिया पोस्ट पेमेंट्स बैंक (आईपीपीबी) डोरस्टेप डिजिटल खाता
ministry: Ministry of Communications
benefit_summary: Zero-paperwork biometric savings account opened at doorstep through Gramin Dak Sevaks, providing AePS cash withdrawal, DBT reception, and bill payments.

ministry: Ministry of Education
sub_category: Scholarship for orphans and children of armed forces martyrs
benefit_summary: Rs 50,000 per year for students who are orphans, whose parents died due to COVID, or children of Armed Forces/Central Paramilitary personnel martyred in action.

ministry: Ministry of Education
sub_category: Prestigious doctoral research fellowship in STEM
benefit_summary: Lucrative monthly fellowship of Rs 70,000 (1st-2nd yr), Rs 75,000 (3rd yr), and Rs 80,000 (4th-5th yr) plus annual research contingency grant of Rs 2 lakh for 5 years.

name_en: National Overseas Scholarship for SC/ST Candidates
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefit_summary: Full tuition fees, annual maintenance allowance (approx USD 15,400 / GBP 9,900), economy airfare, visa fees, and medical insurance to pursue Master's/Ph.D in top 500 QS world universities.

name_en: CBSE Merit Scholarship Scheme for Single Girl Child
name_hi: एकल बालिका संतान के लिए सीबीएसई योग्यता छात्रवृत्ति योजना
ministry: Ministry of Education
sub_category: Scholarship for single girl child in Class 11-12
benefit_summary: Scholarship of Rs 500 per month for up to 2 years for meritorious single girl children who scored 60% or more marks in CBSE Class 10 examination and continue studies in Class 11-12.

name_en: Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan (Free Textbooks, Uniforms & Transport)
name_hi: समग्र शिक्षा अभियान (निःशुल्क पाठ्यपुस्तकें एवं गणवेश)
ministry: Ministry of Education
sub_category: Universal free schooling entitlements from preschool to Class 12
benefit_summary: Free textbooks, two sets of free school uniforms, free transport allowance, and composite school grants for all children in government and local body schools across India.

name_en: PM POSHAN Scheme (Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman - Mid-Day Meal)
ministry: Ministry of Education
sub_category: Hot cooked nutritious mid-day meals in schools
benefit_summary: Free hot cooked nutritious mid-day meal every school day for children studying in Balvatika and Classes 1 to 8 in government and government-aided schools nationwide.

ministry: Ministry of Education
sub_category: Collateral-free higher education loans with full interest subvention
benefit_summary: Collateral-free, guarantor-free education loans for students admitted to Top 860 Quality Higher Educational Institutions (NIRF ranked) with 75% credit guarantee and full interest subvention during moratorium.
